description: Organize your home with the iDesign Vanity Tray. Made of durable, rust-resistant steel with a bronze finish, this versatile tray is perfect for storing any small items such as hand towels, lotion, soap, earrings, necklaces, cosmetics, makeup, mail, office supplies, crafting supplies, and more. The open-top design makes it easy to grab what you need and go - no need to waste time digging to find the matching earring! This tray features non-slip foam pads to provide protection against scratches or damage to your countertop. The iDesign Vanity Tray measures 6.5" x 10" x 1", perfect for your home! With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
